topics: Suicide and crisis line contacts (no method detail)
Staff stress during a long activation
fields.notice: This exercise includes fictional scenes about people in distress and about suicide. No method detail is described and no real person is involved. Some of it may be hard to hear, especially if you have lost someone or work with people in crisis every day.
yourOptions: Step out at any time without giving a reason.
Ask the facilitator to pause the exercise.
Take a break and rejoin later or watch from the side.
fields.supportAtSite: The facilitator and the wellbeing contact, Dana Whitfield, are at the front table all day.
fields.resourcesLine: The employee support program card in your packet lists the services open to Harbor County staff.
